reason: Bending the stock seems like a first step toward a frame for the work area.
expectation: I expect a bent metal frame or parts for furniture, though its exact use is unclear.

alternatives.reason: The trough former looks directly relevant to the growing goal, but I want to start with the work area.

effect: The brake made frame sections, so I can now assemble them with the paving blocks.
reaction: That matches my expectation; I am curious how the blocks fit into furniture.
reason: The blocks and frame sections could form a stable surface or support for the work area.
expectation: I expect a bench or work surface, though I am unsure of the exact structure.

alternatives.reason: Felt and fabric could make a cushion, but I want to build its support first.

effect: The frame and blocks made a bare bench; it seems to need padding to finish the sitting place.
reaction: The bench is a satisfying concrete result, though I do not yet know how the blocks are arranged.
reason: Felt inside spare fabric seems a natural way to make a cushion for the bare bench.
expectation: I expect a cushion or padded covering.

effect: The cushion is ready to put on the bench, as expected.
reaction: A small, intuitive assembly step; nothing surprising.
reason: Putting the cushion on the bench should finish the seat.
expectation: I expect a cushioned window bench and possibly completion of the sitting goal.

effect: The bench also includes a worktop, completing the first goal; the troughs remain.
reaction: The sunset detail makes the work feel personally useful, and clarifies the bench layout.
reason: This is the only offered gameplay action and the trough former directly serves the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect metal troughs or a trough blank that will need the liner.

effect: The stock became growing troughs, and the offered liner is the next obvious step.
reason: A food-safe lining should make the troughs suitable for growing and washing.
expectation: I expect lined, washable troughs and completion of the remaining goal.

effect: The liner completed the washable troughs and both chapter goals are done.
reaction: It finished as expected, though I wanted a little more detail about the troughs or what might grow in them.

mostWorthwhile.text: Finishing the window bench gave the practical construction a human purpose: a worktop and a place to watch the sunset.

leastWorthwhile.text: Forming and lining the troughs felt rather procedural; the result gave little detail beyond their completion.

surprise.text: I had pictured a seat, so learning the bench also had a worktop clarified how it met both uses.

arbitrary.text: The paving blocks and frame naturally suggest a structure, but I could not picture exactly how they formed the bench until the later description.

continue.text: Yes, cautiously: the personal detail of the window seat makes me curious about living here, though the trough assembly itself offered little discovery.
